findings.excerpt: Credit risk dynamics are shifting as improvements in personal loans and private label delinquency are being countered by a rise in severe mortgage delinquency, alongside a worsening in subprime vintages for both Bankcard and unsecured personal loans through 2024.

findings.claim: Fed 信用卡 NCO：Q2 2026 3.70%（Q1 3.66%），與疫情前相近
findings.source: Creditors Bar: Q2 2026 Credit Card Charge-Offs Tick Higher
findings.excerpt: The charge-off rate on credit card loans increased from 3.66% to 3.70%. The charge-off rate continues to be at a level similar to the pre-pandemic period.

findings.claim: SoFi Q2 2026 個人貸款報告 NCO 2.62%（Q1 3.03%），調整出售逾期貸款後約 3.7%；維持累計淨損 7%-8% 指引
findings.excerpt: The personal loan annualized charge-off rate decreased 21 basis points year-over-year to 2.62%, which includes the impact of asset sales, new originations and delinquency sales in the quarter. The annualized charge-off rate decreased from 3.03% in the prior quarter.

findings.claim: SoFi Q2 2026 備抵增加 $5.5M，主因信用卡餘額成長，部分被信用品質持續強勁抵銷
findings.excerpt: of $9.2 million and an allowance increase of $4.5 million. Net charge-offs of $9.2 million increased $2.7 million compared to the three months ended June 30, 2025, driven by higher average credit card balances. The allowance increase of $4.5 million primarily reflected growth in the credit card portfolio balances, partially offset by continued strength in credit quality of the portfolio.
